scope: Immutable successful scalar declaration inventory reused by actual Normalize/Restore consumers; no broader parser/body/Typed/Verify authority
method: Read complete three-file commit diff and current Environment/classifier/reuse/publication, normalization preflight/builder/scalar consumers, original declaration inventory loop, Budget remaining/adopt/node/text and actual storage/owner restoration consumers. No Cargo/compiler/native execution, new tests, measurement, production edits or commits.

conclusions.conclusion: Reusing inventory requires original full Environment.compatible, not narrowed function_inputs_compatible: ordered ModuleId/FileId/path inputs, complete semantic headers, exact current import values including bindings/spans, target/context and all original non-ledger Limits. Original node/work allowances remain monotone consumable quotas with current fit; not falsely described as exact identity. Current scalar classification and current original preflight remain before inventory replay. Index/Functions/files contain only names/flags/canonical module/name owners and FileId-to-position values; no old NodeId, AST, SourceMap or diagnostic Span is stored.

Declaration inventory extraction preserves original statement/order/checks. Saved successful node/work fee is the exact before/after delta. Replay checks both checked_sub operations against current remaining allowances before one adopt_remaining, with no mutation on failure. Fitting full nonnegative text/node fees implies fitting original prefixes; failed fit runs original ordered builder under unchanged current budget/spans. Budget.adopt_remaining only clamps current numeric ledgers and does not clear feature/source-identity flags or invent lineage state. Sealed scalar/origins-none path does not introduce temporary/source-allocation ledger effects from the omitted inventory operations.

Both warm and newly built inventory Arc remain alive through synchronous normalize_scalar. Index and files are passed by shared reference; Functions begins Cow::Borrowed. It checks contains_key before to_mut, so unchanged source canonical names do not force a full map clone. Only genuinely new normalized output names trigger a private owned map. Visitor Restore, storage.restore_functions and products.restore_owners consume borrowed references; no later unconditional table clone was found. No RefCell/shared mutable inventory is introduced.

Changed declaration names/publicness/signatures/domain, imports/aliases, source module/file/path order, target or non-ledger limits break original compatibility and take fresh builder; malformed/duplicate identity is also rejected by current admission/preflight. Reused index never bypasses current input checking or unchanged required body passes. Diagnostic errors use actual current spans on fresh fallback.

Scalar inventory candidate is local to expand_parsed_inner and receives new Arc before body normalization only tentatively. Any Err or Ok(None) before full successful raw construction leaves prior session inventory/environment intact. Session publishes entries/inventory/environment together only at final successful point. Existing checkpoints clone the Arc; no independent unbounded inventory history or prior body ownership table is added.

New tests assert actual shared inventory owner across body/alias/position changes with exact fresh Core/SourceMap equality, replacement on real declaration/import/target/non-ledger changes, old-owner preservation after malformed declarations and current work N/N-1 first-error/recovery comparisons. These assertions were inspected but not executed by reviewer or claimed as passed.
